description: A galaxy of its own, open from the start: press R on the planet map and fly to Corsair Reach. Insect corsairs have raided its worlds and stolen the Stormglass, a Tribal relic that calls the weather. Take back a tropical island from its beach down to the pirates' grotto, shut down the storm engine drowning a rain world, and climb a volcano to put out the forge where the engines are made. Three worlds of levels with their own enemies, Tribals to rescue, keys, switches and secrets, harder as you go.
name: Corsair Reach
shortDescription: A galaxy of its own: three new worlds of levels, from a pirate island to a storm world and a volcanic forge.
